root_idea.summary: A root centered on giving or assigning a beneficial provision that reaches a recipient.
root_idea.development: The basic idea is an allotted gift, originally associated with a provision assigned for a time, and extended to material sustenance, other benefits, and non-time-bound divine bounty.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested active participle, normalized to its singular citation form.

senses.definition: To bestow, grant, or provide someone with sustenance or another beneficial endowment.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive verb that may take a recipient and the provision or benefit supplied as its object; Quranic active and passive forms include providing people with material or other beneficial gifts and being provided with them.

senses.definition: An ongoing provision, gift, or beneficial endowment that reaches a recipient, whether worldly or eschatological.
senses.usage_conditions: May refer to material sustenance, wealth, status, knowledge, or other beneficial bounty; the Quranic use is not restricted to food.

senses.definition: Food or nourishment taken into the body.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for a concrete edible provision or what sustains a person through eating.
A Quranic figurative use in which rain, especially rain that sustains life, is called provision; this sense should not be generalized to every occurrence of the noun.

senses.definition: An allotted share of blessing; by a Quranic interpretation, the acknowledgment or thanksgiving due for a bestowed blessing.
senses.usage_conditions: In the expression associated with 56:82, the share or response to blessing is portrayed as being replaced by denial rather than gratitude.

senses.definition: A provider: one who gives provision or serves as a means by which provision reaches others.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural can refer to providers generally while affirming that God is the best or ultimate provider; the lexical use includes a causal intermediary as well as a giver.

senses.definition: The intensive divine provider: the One who abundantly and continually provides.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as a divine epithet and not as an ordinary human designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give an army its subsistence-money, pay, or regular allowances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional military use with the army or soldiers as recipients.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a place, to be rained upon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive lexical use in which rainfall is expressed as provision reaching the place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the Azd dialect, to thank, show gratitude, or acknowledge another’s beneficence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal verb distinct from the ordinary meaning of providing; it underlies one interpretation of the Quranic noun in the thanksgiving construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or receive one’s provisions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of soldiers receiving subsistence-money, pay, or allowances, and more generally of people receiving means of subsistence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask or demand provision from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The requested provision may be ordinary subsistence or, for a soldier, pay or an allowance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A regular subsistence allowance, especially the pay or allowance assigned to soldiers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May denote food allowance, subsistence-money, or a periodic military payment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single portion or installment of provision or an allowance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Especially used for one payment or one portion of soldiers’ subsistence-money.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Predatory dogs or birds that catch game.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural designation applied to animals that seize prey.
An archaic adjectival use applied to a thing without a specified object class.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A variety of grapes known as Rāziqī grapes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A named grape variety associated with al-Ṭāʾif.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wine made from the Rāziqī grapes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The designation is transferred from the named grape variety to wine produced from it.
Used as a collective designation for the cloth, especially in descriptions of strainers or textile vessels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man possessing good fortune or good worldly fortune.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival passive-participial use describing worldly prosperity or good fortune.

other_classical_meanings.definition: People who receive settled periodic allowances of food, pay, or similar subsistence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can apply even when the recipients are not entered in an official register.
